name: wavecoord
description: Plan tasks in git, dispatch parallel Claude Code workers to local or SSH hosts, collect structured reports, and keep all coordination state in git with rollback

coord_url.title: Coordinator URL
coord_url.description: Base URL of the wavecoord server. The server binds 127.0.0.1 by default.

token.title: Coordinator token
token.description: Bearer token for the wavecoord server. Stored in secure storage, never in git.

project.title: Project
project.description: Project name on the coordinator. Empty means the name from .claude/wavecoord.json in the repo.
